title: Odile and the Safehouse
author: Tamsin Coldharbour
blurb: Ansel Quintana, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
